paired_comparison: trained versus zero adapter with identical initial and transition noise seeds
image_reward: proxy classifier probability of CIFAR-10 frog; proxy trained on 5000 CIFAR-10 train examples
image_independent_check: gold classifier trained on disjoint 45000 CIFAR-10 train examples, scored on held-out test set before RL
video_reward: 0.5 proxy digit confidence + 0.5 visible-motion/smoothness score, guarded by ink mass
video_independent_check: separate MNIST gold CNN digit confidence, static fraction, ink mass
policy_density: exact conditional Gaussian log density for each modified sampler transition; no final-output likelihood claim
video_sampler_caveat: Euler scale 1 follows trained x_data-minus-noise target, while upstream sampling code uses scale 0.1; Gaussian noise is added to nonterminal steps. No marginal equivalence to upstream deterministic sampler
stopping_rule: Do not train if pretrained model loading/inference, numerical checks, classifier quality or local memory gate fails; report failure without substitution
